title: The Listening Room
author: Gideon Almeida
blurb: Yara Almeida, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
